assumptions.text: Momentum weight (0 / 25 / 50%) is open; the preset uses valuation only
Minimum futures share 30% (48m spec); the 24m deck and top-20 use 50%
Target contract price is compared with nearby-derived bounds
Risk reversal = 25d call IV minus 25d put IV; the spec's wording (low percentile = puts cheap) conflicts with this sign, to be resolved with real data
Contract month = exposure month + 2; expiry = last business day of month -2
Percentile = share at or below current, current included
EMA is span 2520 days, not half-life
Stochastic and short-bound parameters are placeholders
Backtest option pricing uses flat vols
No transaction costs or bid-ask in the backtest
